name: A single debt in the current month is the only one in the youngest bucket
title: SC-13-02-06 A single debt in the current month is the only one in the youngest bucket
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
Then unit "A-4" has exactly one open liability: period "Kasım 2026", principal 1500.00, late fee 22.50
And the admin aging report puts principal 1500.00 in bucket "1-30" and shows 22.50 separately as late fee
